story.heading: Since 1875. Still at the same looms.
paragraphs: P K Guled began weaving Ilkal sarees in 1875. Today we are the oldest saree house in Ilkal, working with local weaver families to keep the Tope Teni pallu and Kasuti traditions alive.
Every saree you order is woven, checked and packed at our own store in New Kothwal Peth, Ilkal.

why.heading: Buy from the makers, not a middleman

features.title: Truly handwoven
features.text: Small slubs and yarn variations are the fingerprint of a handloom. No two sarees are identical.

features.title: Signature Tope Teni pallu
features.text: The classic temple-pattern pallu, joined to the body with the traditional Kondi technique.

features.title: Direct from manufacturer
features.text: We weave, wholesale and retail ourselves, so you get the fair price with no reseller margin.

features.title: Care guide with every order
features.text: Dry clean for silk. Hand wash cotton with reetha powder to keep colours rich for years.
